beats.statement: The court of the Mad King assembles, and the Herald opens the show.
The Mad King decrees that the Friday bottle and the throne go to the last contestant standing. The Herald proclaims it.
Kalle poisons a goblet and serves it to Jääskeläinen. Jääskeläinen drinks it and dies.
The Jester speaks a prophecy about who will win the throne, and Aino hears it.
The Mad King sees Aino as a threat to the throne and banishes them from the realm.
The Guard Captain meets Sanna in a trial by combat and wins. Sanna is killed.

announcements.headline: Sanna is OUT
announcements.cause: slain by the Guard Captain in Trial by Combat

beats.statement: Kalle and Pekka swear an alliance to stand together.
Öhman renounces the crown, takes the Grey Cloak and leaves the contest for the Wall.

announcements.headline: Öhman is OUT
announcements.cause: forfeited by taking the Grey Cloak

beats.statement: Liisa faces the dragon alone and slays it. Liisa survives and stays in the contest.
The Iron Vault calls in Matti's debt. Matti cannot pay and is exiled from the realm.

announcements.headline: Matti is OUT
announcements.cause: exiled by the Iron Vault for an unpaid debt

beats.statement: Pekka pays Kalle's debt to the Iron Vault and saves them from exile.
Pekka finds a dragon egg, which protects them from harm for a while.
The Herald wounds Liisa in a fight. Liisa survives, but is hurt.
Pekka tries to stab their ally Kalle in the back, but fails. Kalle survives, and the alliance between them is broken.
The Mad King pardons Pekka for an offence against the crown, for now.
Liisa and Pekka swear an alliance to stand together.
Liisa tries to stab their ally Pekka in the back, but fails. Pekka survives, and the alliance between them is broken.
The Iron Vault calls in Liisa's debt. Liisa cannot pay and is exiled from the realm.

announcements.headline: Liisa is OUT
announcements.cause: exiled by the Iron Vault for an unpaid debt

beats.statement: Kalle and Pekka, the last two contestants, face each other. Pekka yields and leaves the contest.

announcements.headline: Pekka is OUT
announcements.cause: yielded to Kalle in the Last Duel

beats.statement: Kalle is crowned the new monarch of the Bottle Throne by the Mad King.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hear ye! The bottle awaits a worthy hand.

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: I am the Mad King, and this throne is still warm.

lines.speaker: npc_herald
lines.text: Let the peasants step forward!

lines.speaker: npc_herald
lines.text: Silence for the crown!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Only one of you shall wear it. Begin!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere, a goat bleats ominously.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: Is it always like this around here?

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: Strange vintage...

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: Very rare. Very final.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jääskeläinen falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The candles gutter. The seer's eyes roll back.

lines.speaker: npc_jester
lines.text: One who was betrayed by a sworn ally. One who faces a Fool at the last.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Clearly it means me.

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: Somebody should write this down.

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Aino, you are banished. Today.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: You cannot do this!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Crown says I can.

lines.speaker: npc_guard
lines.text: Let the gods decide, Sanna!

lines.speaker: p07
lines.text: The gods owe me money.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The gods do not pay. Sanna goes down.

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: Interesting. Very, very interesting.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: My sword is yours, Kalle.

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: And mine is... somewhere near yours.

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: On second thought, the cold sounds nice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so Öhman leaves the game for good.

lines.speaker: p05
lines.text: And this is why I never sit near the door.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: I challenge you! Please ignore my shaking knees.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: For the bottle!

captions.text: Liisa slays the dragon and survives.

lines.speaker: p05
lines.text: I only borrowed a little crown money.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Vault exiles Matti with interest.

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: The Iron Vault wants its gold!

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: Here. Now you owe me instead.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: A dragon egg! Nobody touch me for a while.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The egg hums. Nobody touches Pekka.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: It is only a flesh wound.

lines.speaker: npc_herald
lines.text: It is quite a lot of flesh.

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: I saw that coming, Pekka.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: Saw what? I was... sharpening a spoon.

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: I am feeling generous. Rise, Pekka.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: Thank you? I think?

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: Together we rise, Pekka.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: Together. Until it is inconvenient.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They shake on it. Both count their fingers after.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: I saw that coming, Liisa.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: Saw what? I was... sharpening a spoon.

lines.speaker: p04
lines.text: I only borrowed a little crown money.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Vault exiles Liisa with interest.

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: Yield, Pekka!

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: I yield! I yield!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so the prophecy is fulfilled.

lines.speaker: p03
lines.text: The bottle is mine!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Take good care of it.

motivations.want: Aino wants the throne, or at least the bottle.
Jääskeläinen wants the throne and a song about winning it.
Kalle wants the throne without ever being in danger.
Liisa wants the throne and a song about winning it.
Matti wants the throne and means to take it by force.
Pekka wants the throne, or at least the bottle.
Sanna wants to win the throne the honest way.
Öhman wants to win the throne the honest way.

chronicle.epilogue: When the dust settled, Kalle the Coward sat upon the Bottle Throne. 7 rivals fell, fled or were sent away along the way. The old crown passed on, the prophecy came true, and the bottle was finally opened. Long may Kalle reign, at least until next Friday.
chronicle.cover_title: The Bottle Throne: Knives Out at the Pub
chronicle.blurb: 8 peasants. One bottle. Alliances, betrayals and a very suspicious goat. Who will be crowned when the curtain falls?
